# M10-S2: logos context prints the declaration, method signatures, and one
# level of mentioned types with no bodies, for .lgo and .go packages.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd ctx

# .lgo package: declaration, method signatures, one level of types, no bodies.
logos context 'example.com/lmod/p#Service'
stdout 'type Service struct'
stdout 'NewService\(cfg Config\)'
stdout 'Start\(ctx context\.Context\)'
stdout 'Stop\(\)'
stdout 'type Config struct'
! stdout 'built-by-newservice'
! stdout 'stopped-by-stop'
! stdout 'type Secret struct'

# .go package: same contract.
logos context 'example.com/gmod/q#Store'
stdout 'type Store struct'
stdout 'Open\(opts Options\)'
stdout 'Get\(ctx context\.Context, key string\)'
stdout 'Close\(\)'
stdout 'type Options struct'
! stdout 'opened-by-open'
! stdout 'closed-by-close'

# Unknown symbol reports the package base and the missing symbol exactly.
! logos context 'example.com/lmod/p#Missing'
stderr '^logos context: p has no symbol Missing$'
! logos context 'example.com/gmod/q#Missing'
stderr '^logos context: q has no symbol Missing$'

cd ..

-- ctx/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./lmod
	./gmod
)

-- ctx/lmod/go.mod --
module example.com/lmod

go 1.27

-- ctx/lmod/p/service.lgo --
package p

import "context"

type Secret struct {
	Token string
}

type Config struct {
	Addr string
	Key  Secret
}

type Service struct {
	cfg  Config
	name string
}

func NewService(cfg Config) *Service {
	return &Service{cfg: cfg, name: "built-by-newservice"}
}

func (s *Service) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.name == "" {
		return errServiceMissing
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Service) Stop() error {
	s.name = "stopped-by-stop"
	return nil
}

-- ctx/gmod/go.mod --
module example.com/gmod

go 1.27

-- ctx/gmod/q/store.go --
package q

import "context"

type Options struct {
	Addr string
}

type Store struct {
	opts Options
	tag  string
}

func Open(opts Options) *Store {
	return &Store{opts: opts, tag: "opened-by-open"}
}

func (s *Store) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (string, error) {
	if key == "" {
		return "", errStoreEmpty
	}
	return s.tag, nil
}

func (s *Store) Close() error {
	s.tag = "closed-by-close"
	return nil
}
